title: Position divergence per underlying: Backtest − Production

annotations.summary: {{ $labels.underlying }} sid={{ $labels.sid }} sno={{ $labels.sno }} — backtest vs production position at {{ $values.B }}x this coin's threshold for 10m (one of the top 5 contributors). Dashboard: Strategy PnL — L4 Underlying.

model.rawSql:
WITH complete AS (
  SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) t FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_prod_v2
  WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE
  GROUP BY t HAVING countDistinct(underlying) = (SELECT countDistinct(underlying) FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_prod_v2 WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE)
),
coin AS (
  SELECT u, t, abs(sum(dp * w) / nullIf(sum(w), 0)) AS adiv
  FROM (SELECT bt.u AS u, bt.s AS s, bt.t AS t, bt.p - pr.p AS dp, pr.w AS w FROM (SELECT underlying u, strategy_table_name s, toStartOfMinute(ts) t, argMax(position, updated_at) p, argMax(weighting, updated_at) w FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_bt_v2 WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE AND toStartOfMinute(ts) IN (SELECT t FROM complete) GROUP BY u, s, t) bt INNER JOIN (SELECT underlying u, strategy_table_name s, toStartOfMinute(ts) t, argMax(position, updated_at) p, argMax(weighting, updated_at) w FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_prod_v2 WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE AND toStartOfMinute(ts) IN (SELECT t FROM complete) GROUP BY u, s, t) pr USING (u, s, t)) GROUP BY u, t
),
top AS (
  SELECT u, s FROM (
    SELECT u, s, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY u ORDER BY contrib DESC, s ASC) AS rn
    FROM (SELECT u, s, avg(abs(dp) * w) AS contrib
          FROM (SELECT bt.u AS u, bt.s AS s, bt.t AS t, bt.p - pr.p AS dp, pr.w AS w FROM (SELECT underlying u, strategy_table_name s, toStartOfMinute(ts) t, argMax(position, updated_at) p, argMax(weighting, updated_at) w FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_bt_v2 WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 60 MINUTE GROUP BY u, s, t) bt INNER JOIN (SELECT underlying u, strategy_table_name s, toStartOfMinute(ts) t, argMax(position, updated_at) p, argMax(weighting, updated_at) w FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_prod_v2 WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 60 MINUTE GROUP BY u, s, t) pr USING (u, s, t)) GROUP BY u, s)
  ) WHERE rn <= 5
)
SELECT coin.t AS time,
       coin.u AS underlying,
       extract(top.s, 'sid=([0-9]+)') AS sid,
       extract(top.s, 'sno=([0-9]+)') AS sno,
       coin.adiv / (CASE coin.u WHEN 'BTC' THEN 0.15 WHEN 'ETH' THEN 0.15 WHEN 'SOL' THEN 0.2 WHEN 'ADA' THEN 0.25 WHEN 'DOGE' THEN 0.25 WHEN 'AVAX' THEN 0.3 WHEN 'XRP' THEN 0.3 WHEN 'FET' THEN 0.4 ELSE 0.25 END) AS value
FROM coin INNER JOIN top ON coin.u = top.u
ORDER BY time, underlying, sid, sno

annotations.summary: Portfolio weighted PnL diverges (Production − Real-Trade) by more than 0.015 for 10m. See dashboard: Strategy PnL — L5 Portfolio.

model.rawSql: SELECT a.t AS time, a.wp - b.wp AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) t, sum(cumulative_pnl * weighting) / nullIf(sum(weighting), 0) wp FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_prod_v2 FINAL WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE AND toStartOfMinute(ts) IN (SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_prod_v2 FINAL WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE GROUP BY toStartOfMinute(ts) HAVING countDistinct(underlying) = (SELECT countDistinct(underlying) FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_prod_v2 FINAL WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE)) GROUP BY t) a INNER JOIN (SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) t, sum(cumulative_pnl * weighting) / nullIf(sum(weighting), 0) wp FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_real_trade_v2 FINAL WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE AND toStartOfMinute(ts) IN (SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_real_trade_v2 FINAL WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE GROUP BY toStartOfMinute(ts) HAVING countDistinct(underlying) = (SELECT countDistinct(underlying) FROM analytics.strategy_pnl_1min_real_trade_v2 FINAL WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 17 MINUTE)) GROUP BY t) b USING (t) ORDER BY time
